conclusion_future_work: This week made me realise that research does not only happen through reading academic texts. Visiting exhibitions, discussing artworks with others, and reflecting on our experiences can also be important parts of the research process.In the future, I hope to explore more exhibitions and use these experiences to develop my own ideas and creative practice.
results_discussion: I think visiting exhibitions is an interesting way to learn about creative technologies. Compared with only looking at images or videos online, experiencing artworks in person can help us better understand how artists use technology to communicate ideas and create experiences for audiences.
title: creative industry research - week 3
introduction: we reflected on our visit to the BFI London Film Festival Expanded. During the class, we discussed the experience and shared our thoughts about the artworks we had encountered.We were also introduced to Practice Grids, a method for organising and reflecting on our creative practice. This encouraged me to think about how my interests, research questions, and creative work might connect with each other.
